Dj.bar_b_note: A large, readable arachnid silhouette, but the uniform chrome-gold shader reads as a statue rather than a living naturalistic creature, and the face and eyes are lost.

Ia.bar_b_note: The fennec-weasel identity reads, but it stands no taller than the 1.80 m trainer and its flat mustard material has none of the fur finish of the style bar.

Yb.bar_b_note: The fur-and-mossy-stone shell boar is naturalistic, bulky, clearly taller than the trainer and believably ridden, which holds up at Palworld finish.

Fy.bar_b_note: B's grounded, mottled black-gold scales come close, but A's flat lemon-on-black skin and the faint frames floating high above their shadow sink it.

Cv.bar_b_note: B's larger, fully wrapped recipe text and blue-grey panel move toward a shipping UI, but the pale-grey Craft and Leave prompts have no teal emphasis and the murky night scene behind adds nothing.

Qn.bar_b_note: The white, blue and orange feathered serpent has a bright, distinct silhouette taller than the trainer and a creature-collector appeal.

Gr.bar_b_note: The naturalistic scaled snake is well made, but its dark brown value merges with the stage and the faint end is nearly the same as standing, head still raised.

Fo.bar_b_note: It matches the owner's Stormursa bar: real fur, purple storm veins, a massive grounded silhouette and readable hurt and faint poses.

Oe.bar_b_note: The leopard-spotted salamander body is good, but it sits low and long beside the trainer, and the faint end shows a dark stretched bar along the tail that reads as broken geometry.

Ld.bar_b_note: The blue-white crested bird is appealing, but it is only about trainer height, and in the carrying frame it hovers alone while the trainer stays on the ground, so the travel role does not read.

Fv.bar_b_note: B adds a timber frame, diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing, but the untextured beige infill, the faceted grey placeholder boulder and the painted-backdrop mountains keep it short of Palworld base-building finish.

Hm.bar_b_note: A storm bear with rich fur, glowing violet lightning veins, strong scale over the trainer and a clear sprawled faint, all at the owner's bar.

Ht.bar_b_note: The navy plated beast with a pale belly and orange spikes has a strong, readable armoured silhouette and a believable mass.

Dn.bar_b_note: The warm, clearly elderly villager has expressive eyes and a green-brown outfit that fits the Meadows palette, though the face leans more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures.

Ah.bar_b_note: The blue-orange finned water dragon is striking and taller than the trainer, though no rider can be clearly seen in the ridden frame at this size.

top_changes.change: Fix creature scale and travel roles: raise Ia, Ld and Oe clearly above the 1.80 m trainer, and actually attach the trainer in Ld's carrying frame (and visibly in Ah's ridden frame)
Rework broken faint reads: Fy A faint frames float off the ground, Gr's faint end is the same as standing, and Oe's faint end shows a stretched dark bar
Give the homestead wall a textured wattle-and-daub or plank infill and replace the faceted placeholder boulder, and give the craft prompts teal button glyphs at higher contrast
